title: Student Union Executive Elections 2026 Official Declaration
author: Election Commission
content: The Election Commission hereby notifies all registered undergraduate and postgraduate students of IIT Rungta regarding the upcoming Student Union Elections 2026. Electronic voting will be active via the official portal.

title: Mid-Semester Exam Datesheet Revised for CS & EC Branches
author: Dean Academics Office
content: Please check the student resource hub for the updated examination timetable. No exams scheduled during the weekend.

title: Registration Open for Rungta Innovation Hackathon 2026
author: Tech Club Union
content: Teams up to 4 members can register. Prize pool of ₹1,50,000 for top 3 solutions in AI, IoT, and Web3 tracks.

title: Campus Wi-Fi Upgrade & Fiber Maintenance Schedule
author: IT Infrastructure Dept
content: Scheduled maintenance will occur this Sunday between 02:00 AM and 05:00 AM. Internet services might experience minor dropouts.
